title: asn2wrs: Remove unicode char '->', it fails on windows

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • 5675b3b6 - asn2wrs: Remove unicode char '->', it fails on windows
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14974/diffs?diff_id=963491958&start_sha=d370b216d2a5aff9c0f617abe1f426e53560d31d)

added 13 commits
  • 5675b3b6...dc5b8b9c - 12 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 5887358a - asn2wrs: Remove unicode char '->', it fails on windows
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/14974/diffs?diff_id=963507387&start_sha=5675b3b67951268333469790c7de734744890f63)
Need to regenerate all the ASN.1 dissectors after this change.
Not sure, the problem only manifested itself when trying to regenerate the dissector and it's only a comment.
